decisions.primaryObject: Transactional cancellation of unsettled agent runs when a conversation is deleted
decisions.reason: The mechanism explicitly governs queued, approval-waiting and running work under the same lock used for admission, making deletion, cancellation and orphan prevention a bounded Digital Employee lifecycle question.
decisions.nextAction: Skill 03 may inspect only cancellation transaction semantics, covered run states, the admission-lock relationship, orphan prevention and explicit limitations.

decisions.primaryObject: Short-lived workload identity exchange with child-process credential boundary
decisions.reason: One concrete implementation exposes an enterprise identity control plane: workload JWT exchange, short-lived credential caching and refresh, plus explicit stripping of launch-context identity from executions, MCP servers, hooks, Git and remote child processes.
decisions.nextAction: Skill 03 may inspect only identity exchange, refresh/coalescing, credential lifetime, child-process stripping and trust-boundary behavior.

decisions.primaryObject: Checkpoint conformance as a detector for persisted-state migration defects
decisions.reason: The change is directly implementable and testable: enabling one shared checkpoint conformance suite across SQLite and Postgres immediately exposed a persisted delta-history migration defect that had previously been skipped.
decisions.nextAction: Skill 03 may inspect only the conformance contract, migrated plain-value seed detection, backend parity, failure reproduction and remaining persistence boundaries.

next.instruction: Research Runtime Reading may consume only Q-20260809-01, Q-20260809-02 and Q-20260809-03 and must execute Skill 03 Deep Reading without Research Analysis or article drafting.

workResult.summary: Executed only Skill 03 Deep Reading for the three selected 2026-08-09 Queue objects after the ordered recovery control plane had restored Reading to Running. Produced three source-traceable Reading Records from merged maintainer implementation evidence. The Langfuse record verifies transactional cancellation of unsettled runs under the same conversation-row lock used for admission while preserving cooperative semantics for already-running workers. The Codex record verifies the short-lived workload-identity exchange primitive, caching, refresh/coalescing, rotation and redaction, while explicitly rejecting the broader child-process stripping claim as unproven by the selected commit. The LangGraph record verifies the persisted plain-value seed migration defect and explains why output correctness could hide an unbounded history replay regression. No Research Analysis, architecture recommendation, article writing or publication was performed.
workResult.summary_zh: 仅在顺序恢复控制面已把 Reading 恢复为 Running 后，对 2026-08-09 Queue 选中的三个对象执行 Skill 03 Deep Reading，并形成三份可追溯 Reading Record。Langfuse 记录确认：删除 Conversation 与未结清 Run 的取消在与 Admission 相同的 Conversation Row Lock 下事务化协调，而已 Running Worker 仍采用协作式取消；Codex 记录确认：短期 Workload Identity Exchange、缓存、刷新与请求合并、Assertion Rotation 和 Token Redaction 均有实现证据，但 Queue 中更广泛的子进程凭据剥离主张不能由该 Commit 证明，因此明确降级为未决证据；LangGraph 记录确认：持久化 Plain Value Seed 的迁移缺陷会在输出仍正确时造成全历史重放，并揭示 Conformance 未实际接入 Backend 时的覆盖空洞。未执行 Research Analysis、架构建议、文章写作或发布。

readings.keyBoundary: Deletion and unsettled-run cancellation share the same durable conversation-row lock as admission; RUNNING cancellation remains cooperative rather than synchronously terminating physical execution.
The selected commit strongly proves the exchange primitive but does not prove the broader child-process credential-stripping boundary described in Queue.

readings.sourceClass: merged maintainer implementation, regression tests and conformance evidence
readings.keyBoundary: A persisted-state migration defect can preserve reconstructed values while violating bounded-replay semantics; conformance protects a backend only when that backend actually executes the suite.

next.instruction: Research Runtime Analysis may consume only these three durable Reading Results, preserve the explicit evidence downgrade on the unproven Codex child-process stripping claim, and execute Skill 04 Research Analysis before Production can resume.

workResult.summary: Executed Skill 04 Research Analysis only after Reading had completed and Analysis had been reopened by ordered reconciliation. Produced three durable Research Objects. The Digital Employee judgment treats destructive context transitions as authority revocation coupled to transactional reconciliation of unsettled child work and identifies a worker lease/watchdog as the missing boundary for already-running execution. The Industry Architecture judgment separates rotatable workload identity, short-lived execution credentials and downstream propagation policy into independent trust controls. The Open-source Engineering judgment treats reader compatibility plus actually executed cross-backend conformance as the governing contract for durable-state migrations, including non-output invariants such as bounded replay. No article drafting or publication work was performed.
workResult.summary_zh: 仅在 Reading 已完成且 Analysis 由顺序恢复机制重新打开后执行 Skill 04 Research Analysis，并形成三份持久化 Research Object。Digital Employee 判断把破坏性上下文转换视为权限撤销与未结清子工作事务化协调，并指出对于已 Running 的物理执行仍需要 Worker Lease/Watchdog；Industry Architecture 判断把可轮换 Workload Identity、短期执行凭据和下游传播策略拆分为独立信任控制；Open-source Engineering 判断把 Reader Compatibility 与真实执行的跨后端 Conformance 共同视为持久化迁移治理合同，并把 bounded replay 等非输出属性纳入验证。未执行文章撰写或 Publication。

researchObjects.judgment: Destructive work-context transitions should revoke authority and reconcile unsettled descendants under the same admission serialization boundary; Running execution additionally requires a bounded worker lease/watchdog.
Rotatable workload identity, short-lived runtime credentials and child-process propagation policy are separate trust boundaries and must be evidenced independently.
Migration safety requires reader compatibility with historical representations and conformance suites that actually execute against every governed backend, including bounded replay invariants.
